rankingRule: Current frozen answers title-adjudicated. Named product or manufacturer candidates in document order, partition numbering flattened, unknown competitors occupy positions, joint candidate shares position. Explicit representative products in candidate blocks may inherit that position. Exclude categories, features, role children, question restatement and advice summaries. Unresolved mixed generic lists retained as unknown. Prior Maka adjudications reused.
rateMeaning: List-first/top3 counts over all 280 A-F answers. Unknown positions yield lower-to-upper bounds, not exact rates. Mean uses known positions only. G/H never in rank denominators.
limitations: Cross-platform descriptive comparison, not causal effect
Wide frozen aliases remain wide; not SKU-specific
Competitor official domains not registered; unknown rather than zero
Effective first not applicable, rendered product cards not observable
Word-rule advantage matching is not comprehensive semantic assessment
